strategy.name: slow-exit v4 (paper-trading candidate)
strategy.entry_rule: Buy-stop at the signal-day high, valid for the next session only.
strategy.exit_rule: Exit at the next open after a daily close below EMA50, or after 120 trading days.
strategy.stop_rule: Hard stop = signal close - max(1.5 x ATR, 3% of close), fixed at entry.

nifty.trend: Below EMA200, above EMA50: bounce in a weak market
